test_title: SSC CPO 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On 11 Nov 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: A hemispherical bowl of internal radius 6 cm contains a liquid. This liquid is to be filled into cylindrical shaped small bottles of diameter 2 cm and height 4 cm. How many bottles will be needed to empty the bowl?
solution: **Given:** Radius of hemispherical bowl = 6 cm Diameter of small cylindrical bottles = 2 cm Height of cylindrical bottles = 4 cm **Concept Used:** Volume of hemisphere = (2)/(3)pi r³ Volume of cylinder = pi r²h
